0.original: Trachraet would commend you for your work among the disparate societies of Eorzea, and entreat your further aid.

1.original: Lieutenant Trachraet expresses his gratitude for your accomplishments, which have laid the groundwork upon which enduring peace with the beast tribes of Eorzea may one day be achieved. Valuing your diplomatic skills highly, he would seek your aid with an important task. Inquire with Lieutenant Gavin of Gridania's Order of the Twin Adder as to the details.

2.original: Lieutenant Gavin is heartened by your presence, having heard much of your peace-building exploits with the beast tribes. To learn more of the task the Twin Adder would entrust to you, speak with the lieutenant anew.

24.original: Speak with Gavin at the Adders' Nest in Gridania.

49.original: There was a time when even mentionin' the notion of peace with the beastmen would've gotten ye laughed out o' Limsa─but no more. Yer efforts 'ave opened avenues once thought impossible.

50.original: ...And ye couldn't 'ave come at a better time. We've received an urgent call for aid from the Order of the Twin Adder. It would seem your services are required in Gridania.

54.original: ...And yet I fear that more pressing matters demand our attention today. When you are ready for your briefing, you need only say the word.
